== Summary ==
Native complete-region comparison for [[Suppressive Fire (V) (Errata)]] and [[Suppressive Fire (V) (Errata 3)]]. Left: [[:File:V8-L-suppressivefire-Set8-archive-2021-10-05-composed.png]], archived 2021 composed PDF region. Right: [[:File:V8-L-suppressivefire-Set8-June-2023-partial.png]], complete June 2023 image with original mask. No card pixels repainted. The2023 set 8 badge is larger and credit/title placement differs; R'kik also has a different frame texture. Identical words alone do not collapse these visibly distinct published layouts.
